page.layout: One printed page of text in a single main column; margin notes at the right ("VI.", "2.TIM.3.", "VII.", "MAT.15.") beside the text; catchword-style signature line "Gcc 4" and catchword "Quisquis" at the foot; running head at top with chapter title and page number.

main_text.p: & qui in dilectione manet, manet in DEO, & DEVS in illo manet. CVM DEO MANERE NON POSSVNT, QVI ESSE IN ECCLESIA DEI VNANIMES NOLVERVNT, ardeant licet flammis, & ignibus traditi, vel objecti bestiis animas suas ponant, non erit illa fidei corona, sed poena perfidiae, nec religiosae virtutis exitus gloriosus, sed desperationis interitus. Occidi talis potest, coronari non potest. SIC SE CHRISTIANVM ESSE PROFITETVR, QVOMODO ET CHRISTVM DIABOLVS SAEPE MENTITVR.
main_text.head: QVAM VERO VNITATEM SERVAT, QVAM DILECTIONEM CVSTODIT, AVT COGITAT, QVI DISCORDIAE FVRORE VESANVS, ECCLESIAM SCINDIT, FIDEM DESTRVIT, PACEM TVRBAT, CHARITATEM DISSIPAT, SACRAMENTVM PROPHANAT?

p.i: Malum hoc fidelissimi fratres, jampridem coeperat, sed nunc crevit ejusdem mali manifesta clades, & surgere & pullulare plus coepit Haeretica perversitatus & Schismatum venenata pernicies: quia & sic in occasum mundi opportebat, praenunciante per Apostolu nobis & praemonente Spiritu sancto; In novissimis, inquit, diebus aderunt tempora molesta, & erunt HOMINES SIBI PLACENTES, SVPERBI, TVMIDI, CVPIDI, BLASPHEMI, PARENTIBVS INOBEDIENTES, &c.

main_text.p: Docet DOMINVS & admonet à talibus RECEDENDVM. CAECI SVNT, inquit, & DVRES CAECORVM: Caecus autem caecum ducens ambo in foveā cadēt. AVERSANDVS TALIS ATQVE FVGIENDVS QVISQVISVII. Mat.15.

page.notes: Marginal references "VI." and "VII." and "Mat.15." are printed at the right margin; the page is slightly faded. Some words in the Greek-influenced and italic lines are uncertain (e.g. "perversitatus", "Apostolu", "foveā cadēt") and are copied as printed.
